hyperedges.label: Prisma contract artifacts that must stay aligned
Statement import pipeline (validate -> parse -> categorize -> dedup -> status)

nodes.label: Bank statement parsers (REVOLUT, MONOBANK, PRIVAT)
nodes.rationale: Raw parsing, categorization, and database persistence remain separate concerns; parsers live under src/imports/parsers/.

nodes.label: Statement upload validation (10 MiB, .csv/.xls/.xlsx, MIME)
nodes.rationale: MIME/extension checks are not proof of safe contents; must be paired with parser-specific format checks and bounded size.

nodes.label: TD-001 Statement import writes are not atomic
nodes.norm_label: td-001 statement import writes are not atomic
nodes.rationale: Pipeline was built first as an HTTP flow with explicit status transitions; an atomic multi-model import operation was not added.

nodes.label: TD-002 Dedup combines pre-read filtering and per-row fallback inserts
nodes.norm_label: td-002 dedup combines pre-read filtering and per-row fallback inserts
nodes.rationale: ORM bulk API may surface a single bulk unique violation; per-row fallback skips only duplicate rows instead of failing the whole import.

nodes.label: TD-003 XLS declared but only XLSX/CSV parsing implemented
nodes.norm_label: td-003 xls declared but only xlsx/csv parsing implemented

nodes.label: Synchronous in-request import processing (no queue/cache)
nodes.rationale: No background worker or retry queue; import status persists in PostgreSQL and the request is held open during parsing and writes.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grep/source reads to get a scoped subgraph; graph.json is rewritten whole on every build so large diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Data model (User, Account, Import, Transaction, Category, CategoryRule)
nodes.norm_label: data model (user, account, import, transaction, category, categoryrule)

nodes.label: Layered architecture: controllers -> services -> Prisma ORM -> PostgreSQL
nodes.norm_label: layered architecture: controllers -> services -> prisma orm -> postgresql
nodes.rationale: Controllers validate and delegate; services own business rules and DB operations; prefer PrismaService.client.orm.public over a separate database abstraction.

nodes.label: Never log passwords, secrets, DB URLs or financial contents
nodes.norm_label: never log passwords, secrets, db urls or financial contents

nodes.label: Compliance posture (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS not claimed)
nodes.norm_label: compliance posture (gdpr, soc 2, hipaa, pci-dss not claimed)

nodes.label: TD-004 Statistics load/scan data without bounded aggregation
nodes.norm_label: td-004 statistics load/scan data without bounded aggregation

nodes.label: TD-005 No health, metrics, or tracing endpoint
nodes.norm_label: td-005 no health, metrics, or tracing endpoint

nodes.label: TD-006 No rate limiting / abuse controls for auth and uploads
nodes.norm_label: td-006 no rate limiting / abuse controls for auth and uploads

nodes.label: Known failure modes (DB, JWT, ownership, import, duplicates, drift)
nodes.norm_label: known failure modes (db, jwt, ownership, import, duplicates, drift)

nodes.label: TD-007 JWT dev-secret fallback easy to misuse
nodes.norm_label: td-007 jwt dev-secret fallback easy to misuse

nodes.label: Engineering standards
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md is the source of truth; this document must be updated to match it when they diverge.

nodes.label: userId ownership scoping rule
nodes.rationale: Every user-owned read and mutation (account, category, import, rule, transaction) must be scoped to the authenticated userId.

nodes.label: Code style (strict TS, import type, kebab-case, Prettier no-semi single quotes)
nodes.norm_label: code style (strict ts, import type, kebab-case, prettier no-semi single quotes)

nodes.label: Testing conventions (Nest testing modules, mock orm at feature boundary)
nodes.norm_label: testing conventions (nest testing modules, mock orm at feature boundary)

nodes.label: Hotfix workflow (standard and urgent)
nodes.rationale: Urgent hotfixes deploy from a branch off the latest production tag so staging tests during code freeze are not disrupted.

nodes.label: PR title prefixes (Feature:, Fix:, Hotfix:, Chore:, Refactor:, Docs:)
nodes.norm_label: pr title prefixes (feature:, fix:, hotfix:, chore:, refactor:, docs:)

nodes.label: Two-branch model (develop / main)
nodes.rationale: Separates ongoing development (develop -> dev env) from production-ready code (main -> staging, tagged releases).
